ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Fraud Cases
ideas.description: Investigate the financial transactions and funding behind the Minnesota fraud cases, including the Feeding Our Future fraud case and the Minnesota Somali Fraud.
questions: What are the sources of funding for the fraudulent activities?
How are the funds being laundered and distributed?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we can uncover the larger network of corruption and fraud, and identify key players and entities involved.
